1: // game.js – simple Asteroid Run implementation
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas> present in the HTML page.
3: // Controls: Arrow keys / WASD – left/right rotate, up thrust.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
10:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
11: 
12:   // ----- Ship -----
13:   const ship = {
14:     x: width / 2,
15:     y: height * 0.8,
16:     angle: -Math.PI / 2, // pointing up
17:     radius: 10,
18:     vx: 0,
19:     vy: 0,
20:     shield: 100,
21:   };
22: 
23:   // ----- Input -----
24:   const keys = {};
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true; });
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
27: 
28:   // ----- Asteroids -----
29:   const asteroids = [];
30:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
31:   let lastSpawn = 0;
32: 
33:   function spawnAsteroid() {
34:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
35:     asteroids.push({
36:       x: Math.random() * width,
37:       y: -radius,
38:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
39:       vy: 1 + Math.random() * 1.5,
40:       radius,
41:     });
42:   }
43: 
44:   // ----- Game Loop -----
45:   function update(dt) {
46:     // Ship controls
47:     if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) ship.angle -= 0.04;
48:     if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) ship.angle += 0.04;
49:     if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) {
50:       const thrust = 0.1;
51:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
52:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
53:     }
54:     // Apply velocity & simple damping
55:     ship.x += ship.vx;
56:     ship.y += ship.vy;
57:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
58:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
59:     // Keep ship inside bounds (wrap horizontally)
60:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
61:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
62:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = 0;
63:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y = height;
64: 
65:     // Asteroids movement
66:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
67:       const a = asteroids[i];
68:       a.x += a.vx;
69:       a.y += a.vy;
70:       // Remove off‑screen
71:       if (a.y - a.radius > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
72:     }
73: 
74:     // Collision detection (circle vs circle)
75:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
76:       const a = asteroids[i];
77:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
78:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
79:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
80:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
81:         ship.shield -= 20; // damage
82:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
83:         if (ship.shield <= 0) {
84:           // Game over – stop animation loop
85:           cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
86:           alert('Game Over');
87:           return;
88:         }
89:       }
90:     }
91: 
92:     // Spawn new asteroids
93:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
94:       spawnAsteroid();
95:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
96:     }
97:   }
98: 
99:   function draw() {
100:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
101:     // Draw ship
102:     ctx.save();
103:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
104:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
105:     ctx.beginPath();
106:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
107:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
108:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
109:     ctx.closePath();
110:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
111:     ctx.fill();
112:     ctx.restore();
113:     // Draw asteroids
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
115:     for (const a of asteroids) {
116:       ctx.beginPath();
117:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
118:       ctx.fill();
119:     }
120:     // Draw shield bar
121:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
122:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 100, 10);
123:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
124:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, ship.shield, 10);
125:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
126:     ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, 100, 10);
127:   }
128: 
129:   let lastTime = 0;
130:   let animId;
131:   function loop(timestamp) {
132:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
133:     lastTime = timestamp;
134:     update(dt);
135:     draw();
136:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
137:   }
138:   animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
139: })();

(End of file - total 139 lines)
